purpose: Response-blind selection of one new repeated-site system for a future mechanism-specific static-versus-sequential Layer-B test. This is not a fourth EOG-WF predictive endpoint.

dataset.title: Ten year camera trap dataset of tigers in India

response_independent_files.name: EEtraplocs.csv
response_independent_files.role: 195 trap IDs with centered x/y coordinates in metres

forbidden_response_file_until_authorized.name: EERecords.csv
forbidden_response_file_until_authorized.role: individual tiger captures by trap, occasion and primary period

response_blind_selection_reasons: ten ordered primary periods support a sequential state-refresh test
195 trap locations provide a repeated spatial node registry
trap geometry is physically separate from tiger capture records
trap activity by primary period is physically separate from tiger capture records
the response file is small and separately addressable, permitting an exact once-only future firewall
no matching tiger/EEtraplocs/EECam_act system was found in the current eog repository
stage0_allowed_actions: reproduce exact trap registry and active trap-by-period calendar
construct response-blind Euclidean geometry ladder from centered metre coordinates
freeze static and sequential feature-generation semantics
run synthetic/placeholder smoke with no EERecords.csv byte access
stage0_forbidden_actions: select a tiger subset after seeing records
change the mechanism hypotheses based on response counts
use the system to improve the favorable/favorable/adverse paper denominator

predeclared_mechanism_contrast.common_node_universe: trap IDs reproduced from EEtraplocs.csv and activity file before response
predeclared_mechanism_contrast.common_world_family: response-blind Euclidean LCC threshold ladder plus external_open; exact thresholds frozen only after geometry file is opened
predeclared_mechanism_contrast.common_prediction_baseline: same strong learner and same response-independent trap/period/effort features in all arms; exact fields frozen after Stage0 schema inspection
predeclared_mechanism_contrast.variant_static_matched: one declared pre-target structural state is reused across later periods, with identical feature-generation function in fit and serve
predeclared_mechanism_contrast.variant_sequential_matched: Layer A and prediction-facing state are refreshed after each revealed prior primary period and always computed before the current target outcome
predeclared_mechanism_contrast.variant_source_symmetric: prediction-facing support aggregates across the declared current source set symmetrically; exact source IDs remain in Layer A
predeclared_mechanism_contrast.training_serving_generator_shift_arm: diagnostic negative-control arm only; deliberately mismatched generation is not an eligible production representation

primary_mechanism_endpoints: within-trap Layer-B refresh fraction across primary periods
feature-vector uniqueness/redundancy relative to spatial node identity

predictive_scores.metric_family: calibration-sensitive heldout log loss with paired unchanged learner; exact split/count rules to be frozen before EERecords.csv access

next_gate: Stage0 geometry/effort acquisition only; EERecords.csv remains forbidden
